no-reader:dlq.title: Dead letters pile up in Dead letters
no-reader:dlq.message: Nothing in the diagram reads or alerts on Dead letters: failed messages stay there until someone looks.
no-reader:dlq.rationale: A dead-letter queue has no automatic cleanup. Someone should be told when messages land there, and be able to replay them.
